subject: Discovery recap — please pick 2 short slots for a 30m walkthrough
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stratusai.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@stratusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — please pick 2 short slots for a 30m walkthrough

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of next-step asks so we can keep momentum: 

TL;DR – you called out query-time cost variability, cold-start latency for batch transforms, and the need to restrict data residency for PII. Success criteria you mentioned: <30ms 95th latency for short text generation, auditable token-level logs for compliance, and a predictable per-token unit cost target.

Key stakeholders to include on the demo:
- Liam (Search/Product) — owner of success criteria
- Priya (Infra/Security) — will validate data controls
- SRE/Platform lead — to confirm deployment/options for private mode

Proposal — a focused 30-minute walkthrough (product + one technical slide deck). Please pick two short windows that work for your team in the next 7–10 business days so we can lock one: 
1) Tue Apr 13 — 10:00–10:30 PT (preferred for our engineering SME)
2) Wed Apr 14 — 16:00–16:30 PT (works if you need later in the day)
3) If neither works, propose two other 30-min windows and we’ll accommodate.

Prep we’ll share before the call: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), and a compact runbook of the demo flow. I attached a first-pass mutual-action-plan draft to show who’s responsible for what post-demo.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), mutual-action-plan-draft.docx

If you confirm one of the above or send two alternatives I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a link to the prep doc.

Thanks —
Marissa
